# Conductor Node State Lexicon

Shared indexed naming for node anatomy in Conductor testbed.

## Indices

1. **CROWN** — corner chrome + breath micro-motion layer
2. **SHELL** — outer frame and depth-shadow mass
3. **CREST** — header row (icon/title/status dot)
4. **TAGRACK** — semantic tags (role/status/awareness/model)
5. **CORE** — primary body content text
6. **PULSEBAR** — working progress strip
7. **ECHO** — latest output snippet panel
8. **TIMESTAMP** — spawn time in footer
9. **LOGCOUNT** — output count in footer
10. **SHIFT-VEIL** — shift-drag overlay layer
11. **INSPECT-TRAP** — planned right-side intent hitbox

## Notes

- TAGRACK tooltips should be derived from node data, not stored.
- Floating informational surfaces should use floating-ui positioning and stay detached from card clipping bounds.
- Interaction precedence should preserve drag ownership while allowing tag clicks to open info surfaces.
